name: Underfoot Combat (Combat)
body:
You are a master of using your size to your advantage against much larger foes.

Prerequisite(s): Small or smaller, Acrobatics 4 ranks, Underfoot

Benefit(s): You can move into or through a square occupied by a creature at least two size categories larger than you without provoking an attack of opportunity.

While in a square occupied by a creature at least two size categories larger than you, you gain cover including from attacks made by the creature in whose square you are occupying.

This feat does not work against creatures who fully occupy their square, like oozes.

Normal: Without this feat, you can move into squares occupied by creatures at least three size categories larger or smaller than you.
